name: OptiFi
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Solana’s ecological derivative OptiFi tweeted that at around 6:00 UTC on August 29th, team members tried to update and upgrade on Solana, but the OptiFi mainnet program was shut down due to an operation error and could not be recovered, of which 661,000 USDC Locked (95% of funds are owned by team members), all user funds will be compensated.
